items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution notice
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated 18.11.2026 (Wed), and in the absence of any other date this is taken as the day it was handed to the post (Aufgabe zur Post). The letter claims the notice counts as Bekanntgabe on the 4th day after posting, but the statutory rule under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X provides for the 3rd day after posting (see warnings for this discrepancy); the correct statutory rule is applied here. 18.11.2026 + 3 calendar days = 21.11.2026, a Saturday; since the fictional delivery day falls on a weekend, it shifts to the next business day, Monday 23.11.2026 (Bekanntgabe). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted for the start of the period, but under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the one-month Widerspruchsfrist ends on the day of the following month that bears the same calendar number as the Bekanntgabe day (23) -> 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies.

items.title: New monthly contribution rate takes effect
items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 betragen Ihre monatlichen Beiträge 318,46 €.
items.computation: The letter explicitly states the new contribution rate applies from 01.01.2027; this calendar date is taken as given.

items.title: First debit of new contribution rate (for January 2027)
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiterhin zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The new rate of 318,46 € covers January 2027. Contributions are debited on the 15th of the month following the covered month ('Folgemonats'), so the first contribution charged at the new rate (for January 2027) is debited on 15 February 2027. 15.02.2027 is a Monday, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.

warnings: The letter states that the notice is deemed delivered on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) after posting, but the statutory fiction under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X is the 3rd day after posting; this discrepancy was resolved in favor of the legally correct 3-day rule when computing the Widerspruchsfrist, but the recipient should double-check the actual posting date with the Krankenkasse if the deadline is tight.
The letter does not separately state the date the notice was handed to the post (Aufgabe zur Post); it was assumed to be identical to the printed 'Datum des Bescheids' (18.11.2026).
The letter does not state the previous (old) monthly contribution amount for comparison, only the new amount of 318,46 €.
